identity_lock.silhouette: Rounded navy beret, low-luminance ash-beige bob, broad rounded face and head, compact navy A-line dress, tan cross-body strap, compact satchel and its single small rabbit remain unmistakable in every frame.
identity_lock.proportions: The approved standing frame is authoritative: preserve its broad head and face, approximately four-head-tall body, short sturdy legs, cylindrical socks and shoe size. Sitting changes joint angles and root height only; it must not slim, flatten, elongate or enlarge the character.
identity_lock.face_and_markings: Pale rounded face, muted blue-gray eyes, fixed fringe and matte gray-beige hair with subdued highlights; only eyelids, gaze, a tiny relaxed mouth and a restrained head tilt may change.
identity_lock.costume: Deep navy beret and dress, cream Peter Pan collar, orange neck ribbon, approved brass-button layout, loose long sleeves, cream lace hem, cream socks, black Mary Jane shoes, tan strap, compact satchel and small white rabbit with orange bow keep their exact topology, count, route and scale.
identity_lock.rendering: Soft polished miniature anime game sprite with fine dark outlines, restrained warm cel shading, subdued hair highlights, fixed orthographic front camera, neutral light and no cast shadow.

action_contract.intent: From the exact approved front idle, she keeps her balance, bends both knees and lowers naturally into a compact floor sit, settles with both legs still anatomically readable, relaxes for a short quiet beat, then leans forward, rises through the legs and returns to the exact same front idle.
action_contract.structure: enter frames 0-7; seated rest loop frames 8-17; exit frames 18-25. The overall sequence is non-looping. Frames 8-17 form a repeatable ten-frame seated micro-action loop whose frame 17 returns toward frame 8 without duplicating it.
action_contract.timing_reason: Sitting changes root height, pelvis contact, leg foreshortening and skirt depth more than an ordinary gesture. At 6 FPS, eight enter frames provide 1.33 seconds to sit, the ten-frame seated loop provides 1.67 seconds of visible resting behavior per repeat, and eight exit frames provide 1.33 seconds to rise.
action_contract.standing_key: Frame 0 is the approved front idle and also the exact visual target for frame 25.
action_contract.descent_key: Both feet remain planted and fully visible while both knees bend, the hips and torso descend, the skirt gathers naturally over the thighs without scaling, and the free hand opens slightly for balance.
action_contract.seated_contact_key: The pelvis reaches an implied ground contact behind the knees. Both thighs project toward the viewer with controlled foreshortening, both shins continue forward and down, and the larger near-layer shoes establish depth while the torso remains front-facing.
action_contract.relaxed_key: The same front-facing floor sit settles without flattening the depth: shoulders soften, the chin lowers slightly and the hands relax while the foreshortened thighs, forward shins and near-layer shoes keep their approved K06 v3 overlap.
action_contract.seated_micro_actions: Keep the entire approved K06 v3 seated body locked while the free forearm approaches one rabbit ear, the fingertips make a light pat contact, one slow blink occurs during the hold, and the hand withdraws toward K06. Only the free forearm/hand, gaze, eyelids and a tiny touched-ear response may change. Head position, torso, pelvis, skirt, legs, shoes, strap, satchel body and rabbit body remain fixed.
action_contract.rise_key: The selected rise uses the user-chosen stand-up-prep-v1 sequence. F19 draws both heels inward and plants both soles; F20 shifts the chest over the feet and loads both deeply flexed legs; F21 delivers the first two-leg push and small hip lift; F22 continues the controlled rise toward the standing anchor.
action_contract.cloth_physics_lock: The dress remains one continuous A-line garment. During descent and rise, its front panel falls over both thighs and the lace hem stays uninterrupted. In the approved front-facing seated master, the skirt wraps over the foreshortened thighs and pools around the grounded pelvis, with one receding lace arc; depth comes from overlap, folds and nearer shoes, never from a flat frontal trapezoid, split fabric or knee holes.
action_contract.locked_elements: Hat, hair identity and luminance, face and head size, body volume, collar, ribbon, buttons, lace hem, strap route, satchel identity, rabbit identity, leg thickness, socks, shoes, camera, canvas and pivot remain fixed.
action_contract.allowed_motion: Root height during enter/exit, hip/knee/ankle foreshortening toward the viewer, mild depth asymmetry between the legs, slight torso pitch during enter/exit, seated free-forearm rabbit pat/withdrawal, restrained eyelid/gaze/mouth changes, perspective-correct skirt pooling and a tiny touched-rabbit-ear response.
action_contract.forbidden_changes: No chair, stool, cushion, visible floor, shadow or extra prop; no compressed standing pose, hovering pelvis, invisible-chair pose, splayed wide-V legs, crossed-leg tangle, vanished or fused legs, hidden shoes, shortened or scaled skirt, knee-shaped hem cutouts, split skirt front, shorts-like crotch gap, narrow torso, small head, thin legs, bright blond hair, detached or enlarged rabbit, opened bag, extra anatomy, text, effects, scenery or watermark.

key_pose_sources.strategy: Generate every new key and later every transition as a separate complete full-character drawing from the canonical identity anchor and approved temporal neighbors. Never construct motion by moving, blending, warping or compositing image parts.

threshold_notes.min_alpha_coverage: The frozen, user-approved seated loop uses its validated 0.10 minimum; F11 and F12 measure 0.1091 and 0.1097 without cropping or missing anatomy.
threshold_notes.max_area_drift: A seated pose deliberately changes the silhouette from tall and narrow to low and wider while all identity landmarks and limb thickness remain locked.
threshold_notes.max_bbox_aspect_drift: Natural hip, knee and ankle flexion makes the seated key substantially wider than the standing anchor without changing body scale.
threshold_notes.max_center_range_px: The root descends through a large intentional vertical range; fixed placement is enforced by the common visible y=472 ground baseline and pivot (256,492).
threshold_notes.max_centroid_acceleration_px: The declared 70px ceiling covers the large standing-to-floor-sitting root change; after all direct frames were added, the measured full-sequence maximum is 33.136px.

post_process.generation: Every motion frame is a separate complete-character built-in image-generation call at 1024x1024 using the canonical anchor and nearest approved temporal keys.
post_process.forbidden: No cut-and-paste parts, local compositing, translated layers, optical flow, cross-fade, morphing, deformation or algorithmic interpolation.
post_process.background_removal: Use a perfectly flat #FF00FF source background, explicit magenta chroma removal, soft edge matte, 1px edge contraction and despill, matching the accepted production edge treatment.
post_process.final_downsample: Uniformly normalize complete drawings into fixed 512x512 cells with high-quality downsampling, x-centered body placement, y=472 visible ground baseline and pivot (256,492).

key_pose_review.scope_note: The complete ten-frame seated loop F08-F17 is user-approved. The user explicitly selected stand-up-prep-v1 for the rise: F19-F22 provide the foot draw, two-foot load, first push and controlled rise shown in its contact sheet. Later hand-motion revisions v2-v4 are rejected or abandoned. All nine missing enter/exit direct frames are now independently generated and the complete 26-frame sequence passes automated and local QA; full-sequence user semantic acceptance and Godot integration remain pending.

revision.user_rejection: The first seated rendering made the lace hem wrap separately around both knees, producing two implausible leg holes.
revision.single_targeted_fix: K04, K06, K09 and K14 now use one connected front skirt panel with gravity folds and one uninterrupted lace edge; seated upper thighs and knees are naturally covered while lower legs and shoes emerge below the common hem.

perspective_revision.failure: The front-on seated construction kept pelvis, knees and shoes in one flat plane, reading as a vertically compressed standing sprite.
perspective_revision.correction: K06 is rebuilt as a front-facing floor sit with pelvis behind the knees, foreshortened thighs, forward shins, larger near-layer shoes and a receding pooled skirt.
perspective_revision.scope: K06 v3 master is promoted and maps to planned frame 008. K04, the relaxed seated key for frame 012 and the rise key for frame 022 remain pending regeneration from this approved depth authority.

direct_frame_review.generation_method: nine separate complete-character built-in imagegen calls with design, pose-family and bounding temporal authorities; no interpolation, optical flow, morphing, warping, local translation or part compositing
